output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
The freezeAccount function has an access control issue where the owner can arbitrarily set whether a user's account should be frozen.
The setPrices function has an integer overflow where the owner can set the prices of the tokens to any value.
The buy function has an integer overflow where the buyer can choose to buy zero tokens, potentially causing the owner to lose a lot of money.
The sell function has an integer overflow where the seller can choose to sell zero tokens, potentially causing the owner to lose a lot of money.
